trigger.novelty_evidence: A current official Binance publication announces a distinct USD1 campaign from 2026-09-04 through 2026-10-02 with a 150 million WLFI pool, after the consumed August campaign ended.

question: What exact official article code and release time identify the new September 4 USD1 campaign in Binance's public campaign-announcement catalog?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one bounded current page of the public official Binance campaign-announcement catalog
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only CMS GET with no account, credential, order, or mutation semantics
endpoint_classification.source_contract: Only returned title, article code, release time, and catalog metadata may select one separately frozen exact article capture.

decision.source_gate_only: Parse titles, article codes, and release times offline; do not use catalog order, snippets, or marketing language as economic evidence.
decision.conditional_next_step: If exactly one current title identifies the September 4 USD1 campaign, exact-URL deduplicate and separately freeze that article before access; otherwise stop without an alias or market request.

retry_policy: This exact catalog-page GET is one-use. Preserve any HTTP, format, byte-limit, missing-field, zero-match, or multiple-match outcome and do not retry an alias, locale, page size, pagination, or search endpoint.
